title: a connection joining ports of unrelated types must be flagged
note: FOUND 2026-09-02 by a Fable advisory, FIXED the same day. A PowerPort wired to a DataPort passed silently. The type check compares the PortDefinition closures of both ends (reached through the implicit end → prototype → FeatureTyping walk) and flags only when they are DISJOINT — a specialised port def still matches its ancestor, and `T` ↔ `~T` is the canonical compatible pair. Silence when either side is unresolved; that is another rule's finding.
